source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Εύδοξιος, Αγάπιος και άλλοι οκτώ μάρτυρες, Αττικός, Μαρίνος, Ωκεανός, Ευστράτιος, Καρτέριος, Νικοπολιτιανός, Στύραξ και Τωβίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates all ten of its members, each with his own heading and the same year, so it is ten folders; seven of them are drafted here, Agapius is an upgrade of the folder the corpus already keeps on this day, and Atticus and Oceanus are refused and reported because their folders already carry venerated Greek rows on other days, 26 August and 12 September, and nothing settles whether those are these men. This Eudoxius is not the corpus's Eudoxius of Melitene, who is kept on 6 September with a company of his own. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
